text: Morning all! Anyone tried the new lor mee stall at the Bedok market? Queue was crazy yesterday
Wah that photo of the old Bedok market brings back memories
My grandma used to buy kueh from the auntie at the entrance every Sunday
Scroll up lah, someone posted about the lor mee last week
Search bar useless, I type "lor mee" also nothing come out
Try searching in English and Chinese both, sometimes works
Forwarded from another group: Uncle's prawn noodle stall closing end of month, go and support!
Is this the same uncle at the Ang Mo Kio one or different?
Different one I think. This one at Tiong Bahru
Admin can pin the closing list? So many stalls closing this year
Pinned. Will update when people share more
Just reached, queue about 20 people for the chicken rice. Worth it or not?
Worth it. Get the roasted, not steamed
Thanks! Will report back
Report: roasted chicken very good, chilli a bit weak this time
Anyone know if the carrot cake stall opens on Mondays?
Closed Mondays and Thursdays I think
Last time I asked this also, check the old messages
I tried but cannot find, Telegram search only shows the newest few
Price went up to $5.50 for the char kway teow. Still worth?
Everything going up. Still cheaper than food court
Remember when it was $2.50 haha
That was 2010 leh
Someone posted this on Facebook, apparently the satay stall owner is retiring
Please don't share photos of the uncle's face without asking him
Ok sorry, I will crop
Who is the admin of the Instagram page ah? They used my photo
The IG is run by two of the admins. Will check
I posted it here for the group, not for everyone on IG
But IG also public what, anyone can see
Not the point. Ask first
Agree with asking first. Some of us don't want to be on IG
Admin note: from now on we will ask before reposting anything to IG
Good decision admin
Anyone tried the durian pengat at the dessert stall? Heard it's seasonal
Only during durian season, around June
Will try then. Saving this message
How to save message in Telegram ah?
Long press, then "Save to saved messages" or just star it
Thanks, I always screenshot instead
My phone gallery full of food screenshots from this group 😂
Same. I screenshot then forget which stall
I keep a notebook, old school but I never lose it
Notebook gang 🙋‍♀️
Anyone remember the name of the fishball noodle stall that was near the old library?
The one with the blue signboard? Closed long time ago
Aiyo I miss that one
There's an old post about it from 2021, someone wrote a long review
Found it! Copy pasting here: "The fishball is handmade, best in the east"
Wah this review aged well, still true until it closed
Can someone check if the nasi lemak at the corner stall still opens at 6am?
Still 6am. I go every Tuesday
Is it halal?
Muslim-owned, but no cert displayed. Can ask the auntie
Thanks, will ask
Forwarded: list of hawker centres closed for spring cleaning in April
Very useful, thanks for forwarding
Can admin pin this one also?
Pinned
Too many pins now, cannot find anything
Admin can make a separate channel for announcements?
Good idea. We will discuss
Today the queue at the bak chor mee was shorter, maybe because of rain
Rainy day = best day for hawker 😂
The famous one in town? Or the Bedok one?
Bedok one
I prefer the dry version with extra vinegar
Vinegar makes all the difference
Old screenshot resurfaced, someone wrote the bak chor mee was "overrated" in 2019
Haha whoever wrote that, are you still here
It was me. I was wrong. Please delete
Admin cannot delete other people's messages unfortunately
It's ok, I'll live with it 😅
This group remembers everything
Group is like our food archive
Better than Google reviews, those are all fake
Some Google reviews are paid, cannot trust
Here we know who is who, more trustworthy
But we also don't know everyone. 2000 members already
True, many new people recently
Welcome to the new members! Please read the pinned rules
Where is the rules message? Can't find
Pinned, first one at the top
Thanks found it
Hello, new here. Any recommendations for vegetarian hawker food in the east?
There's a good vegetarian bee hoon stall at the Bedok interchange food centre
Also the yong tau foo can ask for no meat items
Thank you all!
Anyone know why the popiah stall closed early today?
Auntie told me she had a family emergency
Hope she's ok
Hope everything ok for her
Please don't share personal details about the stallholders, they didn't agree to be discussed
Fair point, sorry
Weekend plan: hawker crawl in Geylang Serai. Anyone want to join?
Me! What time?
10am at the market entrance
Can post photos after for those who can't come
Make sure don't take photos of other customers
Will be careful
Photos from today's crawl: putu piring, mee rebus, and teh tarik
The putu piring 😍
Where's the mee rebus stall exactly?
Second floor, near the toilets. Cannot miss the long queue
Saving this for next weekend
Forwarded from the IG page: "Top 5 hawker stalls in the east according to our members"
Wait, which members voted? I never saw a poll
I think the IG admin just picked
Then don't say "according to our members" lah
Fair criticism. We will do a proper poll next time
Poll: which is the best chicken rice in the east? Reply with your vote
The one at Bedok 85
Bedok 85!
Simpang Bedok one also very good
Is the poll anonymous?
Not anonymous, everyone can see replies
Then I don't want to vote, later people say I no taste 😂
Can use the Telegram poll function, that one is anonymous
Ok admin will set up a proper poll
Lunch today: economic rice, 3 veg 1 meat, $4.80. Inflation is real
Economic rice is my comfort food
My mother brings me to this stall since I was in primary school
Same, my whole family eats there every Sunday
Hawker food is our heritage, must support
UNESCO also recognise already
Then why so many stalls closing?
Rent high, no one wants to take over, young people don't want to work so hard
My son also said he won't take over my stall
Wait, you are a hawker?
Yes, I run a stall in Tampines. But I don't want to say which one here
Respect! Hard work
Don't worry, we won't ask
Morning! Anyone tried the new Korean stall at the food centre? Fusion food at hawker 🤔
Tried it. Not bad but expensive for hawker
Hawker should be cheap and traditional, this one feels like food court
Times change, cannot always be the same
Is it ok to post a screenshot of the hawker's price list? The prices are just displayed
I think it's fine, it's on the signboard
Ok here it is
Thanks, very helpful for planning
Someone from another group is copying our reviews word for word
How do you know?
Same typos 😂 they screenshot and repost
Ugh. Nothing we can do
Can we add a watermark to our photos?
Too troublesome. Just accept the internet is the internet
Anyone know if the soya bean stall still sells the grass jelly mix?
Yes but only in the afternoon
Afternoon only? Last time morning also have
Changed last month, uncle said not enough customers in the morning
Thanks for the update
Uncle at the tau huay stall asked me to tell the group: thank you for the support
Aww that's sweet
Please tell him we love his tau huay
Can someone recommend a stall for a big family dinner? About 15 people
Zi char at the Old Airport Road food centre. Call to book first
Old Airport Road is too far for me 😅
Haha east side loyalty
Why is this group mostly about the east?
Because the founder lives in Bedok 😂
Should we start a west side group?
There's already one, I can forward the link
Forwarded: link to "West Side Makan Kakis" group
Thanks!
Anyone else read this group every morning like reading the news?
Every morning with my kopi
Same. I rarely post, but I read everything
Silent readers unite 🙋‍♂️
I search the old messages before I go out, but half the time nothing comes up
The search doesn't work for Chinese characters, very annoying
Maybe we should make a spreadsheet of all the stalls?
Someone tried in 2022, it's somewhere in the old messages
Found the spreadsheet link! But last updated 2023
Can volunteers update?
I'll help update the east side ones
Spreadsheet is public? Anyone with link can edit?
View only for public, edit for volunteers
Good, otherwise someone vandalise
Is it ok if I share this group's spreadsheet on my blog?
Better ask admin first
Please don't, it's meant for members
Ok I won't share
Today's report: the queue at the famous hor fun stall was 45 minutes
45 minutes for hor fun 😱
The hor fun is good but not 45 min good
The influencer posted about it on TikTok last week, that's why the queue
TikTok ruining all the good stalls 😩
Good for the uncle's business though
True, he deserves it
But regulars can't get their food anymore
Mixed feelings
Morning. Rainy day, perfect for laksa
Which laksa? The one near the old cinema or the Bedok one?
The one near the old cinema
Is it still the same taste after they changed owner?
Not the same. Lighter now
Agreed, not the same
Then I will stick to my memories 😅
Thank you to everyone in this group, I moved here from Malaysia last year and this group helped me so much
Welcome! Glad we could help
Malaysia also has great hawker food, share with us sometime
Will do!
Old message from 2020 resurfaced: "Covid closing everything, support your hawkers"
That time was so tough for the stalls
Many didn't survive
Remember when we all ordered delivery to support them
Our group was very active that time
Good times in bad times
